f.title: Report serious or unexpected adverse reactions within 15 calendar days of receipt or awareness
f.statement: Under the Food and Drugs Act and Regulations, regulated parties must report serious or unexpected adverse reactions as mandatory reports, within 15 calendar days of receiving or becoming aware of the information about the adverse reaction.
f.clause: Report an adverse reaction to a drug: industry (introduction)
f.legal_basis: Food and Drugs Act and Food and Drug Regulations (cited generally)
f.applicability: Drugs: pharmaceutical drugs (prescription and non-prescription), biologics (biotechnology products and fractionated blood products) and radiopharmaceutical drugs

rows.deadline: Within 15 calendar days of receiving or becoming aware of the information

f.title: Market authorization holders may enrol with the Canada Vigilance TPMO to submit electronic ADR reports
f.statement: The Canada Vigilance Program accepts electronic adverse reaction reports. Its Trading Partner Management Office (TPMO) accepts reports from enrolled trading partners and applications for enrolment from market authorization holders; holders contact the TPMO to obtain the e-reporting guidance document or to enrol.
f.systems: Canada Vigilance Program; Trading Partner Management Office (TPMO)
